rows.quote: A member may not be the prime sponsor of more than seven bills introduced after 5:00 p.m. on the fourth day of each regular session.
rows.note: The member counted is the first name on the measure (the prime sponsor). Bills introduced before the cutoff are not capped by this rule.

rows.quote: A Member may introduce not more than 35 bills in the regular session.
rows.note: The rule says 'regular session'; the 2025-26 Regular Session runs across two calendar years, so the count spans the whole two-year session. 'Bill' includes a constitutional amendment. Rule 49(b): the rule may be suspended for a particular bill by approval of the Committee on Rules.

rows.quote: A Member of the Senate may introduce or subsequently author not more than 35 bills in the regular session.
rows.note: The rule says 'regular session'; the 2025-26 Regular Session runs across two calendar years, so the count spans the whole two-year session. Rule 22.5(b): the rule may be suspended for a particular bill by approval of the Committee on Rules.

rows.note: Of the five bills, not more than two may be requested after the December 1 that precedes the regular session (December 15 for a member new to an odd-year session). The Senate and House Committees on Delayed Bills may give permission to exceed the limit. Applies to each regular session; the General Assembly meets in a regular session every year.

rows.note: Under Rule 49.3(b) a member may petition the Rules Committee for an exception on or before the twentieth legislative day; a majority of the Rules Committee's total membership approves.

rows.note: Applies to drafting requests made after 5 p.m. on December 5 before a regular session; before that a member may request an unlimited number. At least five of the seven must be requested before the session convenes. Regular sessions are held in odd-numbered years.

The Legislature meets in a regular session in odd-numbered years.

rows.note: This is a statute limiting bill draft requests, not a chamber rule. The Legislature meets in a regular session in odd-numbered years.
